summary: Comprehensive backend testing of file attachment feature for outbound email replies. All 20 automated tests passed. Frontend code review confirms proper implementation of File button, file input, and attachment rendering in TicketConversation and EmailMessage components.
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ POST /api/attachments/upload endpoint in email.py (lines 124-175) correctly uploads files to /app/backend/uploads/ and stores metadata in MongoDB file_attachments collection
✓ GET /api/attachments/{file_id} endpoint (lines 178-193) correctly serves files by file_id with proper content-type
✓ DELETE /api/attachments/{file_id} endpoint (lines 196-213) correctly deletes file from disk and MongoDB with uploader authorization check
✓ Upload validation rejects files >7MB (MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE constant, line 60)
✓ Upload validation rejects disallowed file types via ALLOWED_ATTACHMENT_TYPES set (lines 40-58)
✓ POST /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/notes in tickets.py (lines 203-322) accepts attachment_ids parameter and stores attachment metadata in message document
✓ InternalNoteCreate schema in schemas.py (line 154) has attachment_ids: Optional[List[str]] = [] field
✓ send_email() function in email_service.py (line 146) accepts 'attachments' parameter and builds MIME multipart/mixed with file attachments (lines 186-237)
✓ Frontend TicketConversation.js has File button with data-testid='attach-file-btn' (line 685) and hidden file input with data-testid='file-input' (line 701)
✓ Frontend EmailMessage.js renders outbound attachments with download links, properly prefixing download_url with BACKEND_URL (lines 324-360)
✓ Frontend useTicketDrawer.js has attachedFiles state, handleFileUpload handler (lines 887-932), and removeAttachedFile handler (lines 934-941)
✓ TicketDrawer.js passes all file attachment props to TicketConversation (lines 107-111)
✓ Send button enabled when files are attached even without text (line 739 in useTicketDrawer.js)
✓ Attachment metadata includes file_id, original_name, content_type, size, download_url - all correctly stored and returned
